title: SDLC Task-Local Reference v2
description: A deterministic JSON-path-like reference into the current task object, rooted at intent or result and ending with an entity ID.
$comment: The envelope task property is intentionally elided. #intent/objectives/OBJ-001 maps to task.intent.objectives[] where id=OBJ-001; #result/implementation/changes/CHANGE-001 maps to task.result.implementation.changes[] where id=CHANGE-001. The path is structural and does not require schema inference.
